messages:
Nina (AE): Evan says POC is blockedtheir compliance team refuses cross-border processing. Tried to pin 'redwood-7b-v1' in uk-south and got 503s. Need immediate path to keep pilot next week.
Evan (Client-Oxbridge): We got repeated 503/503 downstream errors when calling /v1/generate with region=uk-south. Logs pasted below.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Can you paste the request id? 503 usually means no active replica for that model in region or transient scheduler issue.
Evan (Client-Oxbridge): Request id: req_20260321_abc123; log: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai (region: uk-south)
Body: {"model":"redwood-7b-v1","prompt":"Summarize..."}
-> 503 {"error":"no_replica_available","code":"MODEL_UNAVAILABLE"}
```
Marta (Eng-Platform): Inventory check: uk-south shows redwood-7b-v1 flagged as deprecated for that zone in last sync. Replica heap marked drained on 2026-03-18. Ticket INFRA-7001 captures replication failure.
DeployBot: Scheduled job sync-models-uk-south ran 2026-03-18 03:14 UTC: exit_code=1 (capacity alloc fail).
Leo (Solutions Eng): Two paths: (1) quickest: propose routing POC to uk-west where model exists; get client signoff and update JIRA access control. (2) spin up temporary dedicated replica in uk-south (requires infra approval + ~48h). (3) use 'redwood-7b-compat' quant variant in uk-south and run a short fidelity test.
Evan (Client-Oxbridge): Compliance: no cross-border allowed for pilot. So uk-west is off the table unless we get an exception. They want in-region or dedicated.
Compliance: We can do a one-time exception with a signed Data Processing Addendum if the customer agrees to limited retention and audit logs. Otherwise dedicated in-region is required.
Nina (AE): Customer asks for cost & ETA for a 2-week dedicated test (single pinned model). Finance, ballpark?
Leo (Solutions Eng): Ballpark for 2-week dedicated: node provisioning + reserved capacity + network buffer ~ $6k-$9k. I'll confirm exact SKU tomorrow.
Marta (Eng-Platform): If infra approves, we can allocate a minimal replica (1 A10/medium) for a short test. Lead time 24-72h depending on cluster draining. INFRA-7001 needs priority flag.
Evan (Client-Oxbridge): Time is tight. Pilot must run Mon morning (in 5 business days). If dedicated takes too long, we'll consider the quant variant but need objective eval.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Ask client for 30 representative prompts; we can run A/B: redwood-7b-v1 (hosted in uk-west) vs redwood-7b-compat (uk-south). We'll provide scorecards: BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics + human QA notes within 36h.
Marta (Eng-Platform): Action items: escalate INFRA-7001 with priority tag; estimate cost for 1-node dedicated; confirm cluster availability. ETA for those updates: 1 business day.
Nina (AE): I'll collect the prompt set and compliance contact. Also looping Finance on the cost estimate.
DeployBot: INFRA-7001 updated: priority=requested_by_sales. Added label: uk-south-replication.
Leo (Solutions Eng): If we provision dedicated trial, we'll pin to snapshot id (sha-7b-20260301) to prevent future deprecation drift. Also will include an automated rollback policy.
Compliance: Draft DPA exception for cross-zone routing ready for review; includes 30-day retention limit and audit log requirement. ETA 48h.
Evan (Client-Oxbridge): Sending prompt set now. Appreciate the quick turn.
Nina (AE): Summary & next steps pinned: 
- Sales: confirm customer approval for exception OR greenlight dedicated spend.
- Eng-Platform: escalate INFRA-7001, provide provisioning ETA + cost.
- Solutions Eng: run A/B fidelity test once prompts arrive (36h).
We'll reconvene in 24h. :thumbsup:
